title: Anthropic and Accenture scale enterprise Claude deployment ahead of new safety coordination
summary: Anthropic and Accenture detailed the next phase of their AI safety partnership this week, with Accenture naming Claude its preferred frontier model for regulated-industry rollouts across financial services, public sector and healthcare. The expanded work adds red-teaming, model evaluation and frontier-risk review to Accenture's existing migration and fine-tuning practice, and tracks the cross-lab safety coordination OpenAI confirmed this month. OpenAI endorsed independent verification under the FRONTIER Act.
